storage: git-versioned derived artifact datacore/aircraft/entity_spine.json (whole-file rebuild per refresh, NOT append-only — the FAA registry is a snapshot source; history lives in git)
written_by: scripts/build_entity_spine.py (Python, session-run; never on Railway — see cot.json _note on envelope-test coverage of Python writers). Served by server/aircraftEntities.ts /api/data/aircraft/entity/:hex.
source: FAA Releasable Aircraft DB (MASTER.txt x ACFTREF.txt) joined to OUR archived icao24 hexes from /api/data/aircraft/hexes — only observed airframes, never the full registry dump
license: US government work, public domain; attribution 'FAA Aircraft Registry'

field_map.<hex>: top-level key under entities: icao24 (lowercase) -> record below
field_map.mfr/model: manufacturer + model via ACFTREF join on MFR MDL CODE
field_map.evidence: GIP envelope: source, retrieved date, match basis (exact Mode S hex)

confidence_model: Inference-free exact-key join — every record carries its evidence envelope. Unmatched hexes (non-US/unassigned, ~22% of archive) are ABSENT, never guessed. Staleness = evidence.retrieved vs FAA's continuous updates; refresh cadence below.
geo_fields: (none — identity data; positions live in the aircraft stream)
cadence: session-run refresh ~monthly (FAA updates continuously; archived-hex set grows daily via /api/data/aircraft/hexes)
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04). BUILD ORDER 2 #1 / GIP Part 3b v1: the entity-continuity substrate for the fleet-utilization x earnings hypothesis (gate 1 = join accuracy vs known corporate tails).
